capabilities: Schedule tasks with dates and times down to seconds
Query tasks by date and time values
Set Obsidian reminders with a structured snapshot for agent automations
Edit task importance and urgency in four quadrants
Review and bulk-update tasks in a dashboard with saved views
disambiguation: An independent fork of the Tasks plugin adding time precision, not presented as an official replacement for it.
extras: Not yet in the Obsidian Community Plugins directory; must be installed manually from release files. States it makes no network requests or telemetry and points to PRIVACY.md.
intentEvidence: Tasks Datetime is a modified derivative of obsidian-tasks-group/obsidian-tasks.
motivation: The README says it exists for people whose planning needs cannot be represented by a calendar date alone.
problem: The Tasks plugin only supports date-only task scheduling, which cannot represent planning needs that require time-of-day or seconds precision.

relations.evidence: Tasks Datetime is a modified derivative of obsidian-tasks-group/obsidian-tasks.

summary: Fork of the Obsidian Tasks plugin that adds optional time-of-day and seconds precision to task dates, plus reminders and a task dashboard.
